name: hauls-chrome-extension
description: HAULS price-intelligence browser extension (Chrome MV3, Firefox-ready) with Supabase backend.

scripts.test:unit: node extension/selfcheck.js && node extension/reviews.test.js && node extension/shopify.test.js && node tests/unit/all.js
